# Techno Tronics Ltd
> Premium electronics and gaming retailer in Mauritius.

## About
Techno Tronics Ltd is Mauritius's premier destination for consumer electronics, gaming hardware, and accessories. We offer authentic products with warranty, competitive pricing in Mauritian Rupees (MUR), and island-wide delivery.

## Products
We sell laptops, desktops, PC components, gaming hardware, monitors, networking equipment, storage devices, and accessories.

## Location
Mauritius (island-wide delivery and store pickup available)

## Services
- Online shopping with secure checkout
- Store pickup
- Home delivery across Mauritius
- Technical support and advice

## Currency
All prices in Mauritian Rupees (MUR / Rs). Prices are VAT-inclusive (15%).
